meta.name: azure-cost
meta.description: Azure cost management: query costs, forecast spending, optimize to reduce waste. WHEN: "Azure costs", "Azure bill", "cost breakdown", "how much am I spending", "forecast spending", "optimize costs", "reduce spending", "orphaned resources", "rightsize VMs", "cost spike", "reduce storage costs", "AKS cost". DO NOT USE FOR: deploying resources, provisioning, diagnostics, or security audits.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 查询并优化 Azure 云支出，降低浪费
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常为 Azure 账单过高而烦恼
copy.tagline_en: Query and optimize Azure cloud spend, reduce waste
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often worry about high Azure bills

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 可以回答 Azure 的费用问题:报告已发生的费用、预测未来的开支,并给出降低浪费的建议。它会调用 Azure 成本管理接口,而且需要成本读取权限。
howto.when: 当用户问 Azure 账单、成本预测或省钱优化时触发。常见触发词如“Azure costs”“cost breakdown”“optimize costs”等;不用于资源部署、安全审计。

say.text: 我这个月 Azure 花了多少?
say.note: Claude 查询当前订阅已产生的成本。

say.text: 帮我预测未来一个季度的 Azure 成本。
say.note: Claude 运行预测 API 并给出预估。

say.text: 怎么减少 Azure 存储的花费?
say.note: 进入存储成本优化流程,提供建议。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can answer Azure cost questions: report incurred costs, forecast future spending, and suggest ways to reduce waste. It calls the Azure Cost Management API and needs read-only cost permission.
howto.when_en: Use when the user asks about Azure bills, forecasts, or cost savings. Example trigger phrases: “Azure costs”, “cost breakdown”, “optimize costs”. Not for deployment or security audits.

say_en.text: How much did I spend on Azure this month?
Forecast my Azure costs for next quarter.
say_en.note: Runs the forecast API and returns an estimate.

say_en.text: How can I lower my Azure storage costs?
say_en.note: Starts the storage cost-optimization workflow and gives suggestions.
